hints.title: Row Similarity Invariant
hints.text: Valid chessboards require all rows to be either identical to the first row or its exact bitwise complement.

hints.title: Balance of Zeros and Ones
hints.text: The count of zeros and ones in the first row and column must differ by at most one.

hints.title: Minimum Moves from Parity
hints.text: Count mismatches against standard alternating patterns. If n is even, choose the minimum mismatch across both phases; if odd, choose the pattern matching dimension parity.

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Breadth-first search over row and column permutations suffers factorial complexity.

complexity.interviewerExpectation: Prove that row operations and column operations commute and are mathematically independent.
